title: 019 两界牌020 恶心死他
content_zh:
：管明晦忍气吞声，连连退让，换来的是陆敏的步步紧逼，得寸进尺。
他脑袋一热，就要跟陆敏拼命，什么李静虚，臭傻比，来就来，老子跟你们拼了，大不了再死一次！
他把玄阴炼魄阵发动起来，将陆敏裹在里面。
陆敏的太乙神雷十分厉害，对左道邪魔的法术都还有克制作用。
蜀山世界中，以峨眉、青城两派最擅长这乾天太乙神雷。
原著中，晓月禅师豁出十年寿命使出来的十二都天神煞，被峨眉派的苦行头陀一道太乙神雷就给破了。
李静虚与人斗法，也不用别的，一道神雷，就干翻大半个崆峒派的左道修士。
陆敏腹中太白金丹以玄门正宗心法修成，品质远超崔海客的青萍金丹，用来发动太乙神雷，威力更大。
一道道金光从他左手指诀迸射出来，射到玄阴阵中，炸得黑眚丝断裂破碎，玄阴火溃散飞溅！
他那太白分光剑也厉害，配上分光剑法，右手剑诀指定两口精白剑光，上下飞舞，所向披靡。
玄阴聚兽幡上的兽魂被纷纷炸碎，若非有幡保护，挨上一道雷便魂飞魄散了。
管明晦操纵阵法，不断调转五行，挪移方位，陆敏向南放出飞剑，他就调南做北，把分光剑瞬移到北面。
陆敏向东发射太乙神雷，他再转东为西，把一连串的神雷瞬移到西面。
陆敏剑雷齐发，打出去都落在黑暗中，接着听到数十丈外传来密集雷声，也是暗暗吃惊，没想到妖尸阵法竟然有这般玄妙。
管明晦迅速稳住阵脚，先将他困在阵中，再施法令被炸散的兽魂重新从幡中化生出来。
山魈、木魃、马熊、吹蚺、獠豺、葛魍……一只只兽魂裹在涌动的黑眚地煞之中，此起彼伏，时隐时现。
他们发出连声兽吼，震天咆哮，喷射出大量黑眚丝和玄阴冷焰。
黑煞如潮，冷焰如冰，被阴风裹着，从四面八方向陆敏抛洒冲击。
太白分光剑灵性十足，不但不惧邪污，被挪移到其他角落也会自动飞回主人身边，陆敏左手雷右手剑，四面狂轰滥炸。
除此之外，陆敏身上那件离垢钟也是件宝贝。

离垢钟是用鲛绡织成，形如一个丝罩，祭出来化作一幢彩云将人护住，水火风雷，俱都难以侵害。
玄阴冷焰冲到近处，就被彩云阻隔，距离陆敏本身尚有数丈距离。
管明晦见无法破防，便转手一挥，把崔海客跟杨鲤隔空摄来，劈手砸向陆敏。
陆敏看到两人落入阵中，撑开彩云将师徒两个护住。
杨鲤满脸惊惶和愤怒，大声吼道：“陆师伯快把我们推开，不要靠近……”
陆敏没弄明白怎么回事，就看到杨鲤跟崔海客双手向前，猛地迎面扑到，二十根手指宛如铁锥，狠狠地插进他的身体！
胸腹之间传来剧痛，陆敏大吃一惊，随即怒道：“你们这些散仙果然立身不正，与妖尸蛇鼠一窝！”
他左手发雷，炸在杨鲤胸口，金色的电光在杨鲤身体里面爆闪乱窜。
杨鲤体内是太阴精血，已经是妖尸之属，正被这种玄门神雷克制，当场炸得魂动魄摇，直接丧命，尸身向后飞撞出去，滚入黑煞中。
content_en:
: Guan Minghui swallowed his anger and made concessions repeatedly, but in exchange for this, Lu Min pressed forward step by step, taking advantage of the situation.
As soon as his head gets hot, he will fight Lu Min, Li Jingxu, Silly Bi, come here, I will fight with you, the worst is to die again!
He activated the Xuanyin Soul Refining Formation and wrapped Lu Min in it.
Lu Min's Taiyi Divine Thunder is very powerful and has a restraining effect on the spells of evil spirits.
In the world of Shushan, the two factions of Emei and Qingcheng are the best at this Qiantian Taiyi Divine Thunder.
In the original work, Zen Master Xiaoyue sacrificed his ten years of life to use the Twelve Heavenly Gods, but they were destroyed by the Taiyi Divine Thunder from the ascetic Tutuo of the Emei Sect.
When Li Jingxu fought with others, he didn't need anything else. He could defeat most of the leftist monks of the Kongtong Sect with a single blast of divine thunder.
The Taibai Golden Pill in Lu Min's belly was cultivated using the authentic Xuanmen method. Its quality was far superior to Cui Haike's Qingping Golden Pill. It was used to activate the Taiyi Divine Thunder, which was even more powerful.
Streams of golden light shot out from the finger tips of his left hand and shot into the Xuanyin formation, causing the black silk threads to break and shatter, and the Xuanyin fire to collapse and splash!
His Taibai splitting light sword is also very powerful, coupled with the splitting light sword technique, the sword formula in his right hand specifies two fine white sword lights, flying up and down, making him invincible.
The beast souls on Xuanyin's beast-gathering flag were blown to pieces one after another. If it were not protected by the flag, they would have been blown away by a thunder.
Guan Minghui manipulated the formation, constantly turning the five elements and moving the direction. Lu Min released the flying sword south, and he turned south to north, teleporting the light splitting sword to the north.
Lu Min fired the Taiyi Divine Thunder to the east, and then turned east to west, teleporting a series of divine thunder to the west.
Lu Min fired his sword and thunder, and all of them fell into the darkness. Then he heard dense thunder coming from dozens of feet away, and he was also secretly surprised. He didn't expect that the demon corpse formation was so mysterious.
Guan Minghui quickly stabilized his position, first trapped him in the formation, and then cast a spell to regenerate the scattered beast soul from the flag.
The mandrill, the wood demon, the horse bear, the blowing anaconda, the jackal, the kudzu...the beast souls are wrapped in the surging black earth evil, one after another, disappearing and appearing.
They let out continuous beast roars, roaring to the sky, and sprayed out a large amount of black silk and Xuanyin cold flames.
Black evil was like the tide, cold flames were like ice, wrapped in the dark wind, and struck Lu Min from all directions.
Taibai's light-splitting sword is full of spirituality. Not only is it not afraid of evil, but it will automatically fly back to its owner if it is moved to other corners. Lu Min's left-hand thunder sword and right-hand sword are bombarded in all directions.
In addition, the Li Gu clock on Lu Min is also a treasure.
The Ligu Bell is made of crocodile yarn and is shaped like a silk cover. When it is sacrificed, it turns into a colorful cloud to protect people. It is invulnerable to water, fire, wind and thunder.
Xuanyin Lengyan rushed close, but was blocked by colorful clouds, still several feet away from Lu Min himself.
Guan Minghui saw that he could not break through the defense, so he waved his hand, photographed Cui Haike and Yang Li from the air, and smashed their hands at Lu Min.
Lu Min saw the two people falling into the formation, and held up Caiyun to protect the master and apprentice.
Yang Li's face was full of panic and anger, and he shouted loudly: "Uncle Lu, push us away quickly, don't come close..."
Lu Min didn't understand what was going on, but he saw Yang Li and Cui Haike thrust their hands forward and rushed towards him. Twenty fingers were like iron awls, piercing his body fiercely!
There was a sharp pain in his chest and abdomen. Lu Min was shocked, and then said angrily: "You immortals are really not upright, and you are in the same nest with the demon corpse, snake and rat!"
He fired a thunder with his left hand, which exploded on Yang Li's chest, and golden electric light flashed around inside Yang Li's body.
Yang Li's body contained Taiyin essence and blood, and he was already a demon corpse. He was being restrained by this Xuanmen divine thunder, and was blown away on the spot. He was killed immediately. His body flew backwards and rolled into the black evil.
